profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Go, AWS, Distributed Systems) | Building Agentic AI Systems & LLM-Powered Workflows
profile.summary: I’m a Senior Software Engineer specializing in backend development, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures—primarily working in Go within AWS. My career began in cybersecurity and large-scale data systems, and that foundation has shaped the way I build highly reliable, scalable, and observable services.Recently, I’ve been transitioning deeper into AI engineering. I’m building hands-on experience with LLMs, vector databases, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and production-ready AI tooling.At Capital One my day-to-day work is centered around backend Go microservices that power high-throughput, mission-critical realtime pipelines. Alongside that work i'm developing internal agentic AI tooling that improves developer workflows. Outside of work, I build AI-driven side projects—WhatsApp agents, PDF chatbots, workflow automation tools, and internal assistants—to sharpen my end-to-end understanding of modern AI systems. I’m focused on becoming a strong AI engineer who brings deep backend experience, distributed systems thinking, and practical, product-minded execution to the next generation of intelligent applications.
